WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(25,5),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD)),0) ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT)),0) GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(25,5),TS_CNT)),0) TS_CNT_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT CONVERT(numeric(25,5),REPLACE(H,'F-','')) COUNT_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD) ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT) GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT_src
, CONVERT(numeric(25,5),TS_CNT) TS_CNT_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_tgt
, GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT_tgt
, TS_CNT_tgt
, ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_src
, GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT_src
, TS_CNT_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [EDS].[EDS_HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT 
CAST(COUNT_SRC AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS NUMERIC(25,5)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_tgt
,CAST(GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT_tgt
,CAST(TS_CNT_tgt AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TS_CNT_tgt
,CAST(ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_src
,CAST(GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT_src
,CAST(TS_CNT_src AS NUMERIC(25,5)) TS_CNT_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_src
, GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT_src
, TS_CNT_src
 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD_tgt
, GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT_tgt
, TS_CNT_tgt
 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
